children.value: > Fact From Story: OpenAI said it has pushed out its co-founder and CEO Sam Altman after a review found he was “not consistently candid in his communications” with the board of directors.
> > Fact From Story: “The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI,” the artificial intelligence company said in a statement.
> > > Fact From Story: OpenAI declined to answer questions on what Altman’s alleged lack of candor was about.

> > > Fact From Story: Altman’s “departure follows a deliberative review process by the board, which concluded that he was not consistently candid in his communications with the board, hindering its ability to exercise its responsibilities.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone is not consistently candid, it is reasonable to assume they are being dishonest or hiding something.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If a board does not have confidence in a CEO, they are likely to remove the CEO.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Removing someone from their position means they no longer hold that position.
